usage: This is the standard, everyday way to ask for a price in Morocco, used in souks, taxis, and modern stores alike. It is completely neutral in formality and can be said to anyone. The word 'hada' (this) changes to 'hadi' if the object is feminine, or 'hado' for plural items.

variants.label: feminine item
variants.note: Use this when pointing at or referring to a grammatically feminine object.

variants.label: plural items
variants.note: Use this when asking for the total price of a group of items.

variants.label: naming the item
variants.note: Use this followed by a specific noun, like 'bsh7al had l-ktab?' (how much is this book?).

examples.english: Excuse me, how much is this?

examples.arabic: بْشْحال هادي؟ واش تْقْدْر تْنْقْص شْوِيّة؟
examples.transliteration: bsh7al hadi? wash tqdr tnqs shwiya?
examples.english: How much is this? Can you lower the price a little?
